upload_package_to_onedocker_repo: run the onedocker CLI to upload a package binary to the one docker repository
archive_package_in_onedocker_repo: run the onedocker CLI to archive a specific version of a package in the repository
test_package_in_container: run the onedocker CLI to start a test container and stream logs for a package
show_package_versions: run the onedocker CLI to list available versions of a package in the repository
stop_onedocker_container: run the onedocker CLI to stop a running container by its container ID
